items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And a cab stopped and we were on the side of Lafayette and a little guy got out and Zutty said, there's Don Redman.

ctx.x: Well how did Don Redman come in on that?
Well Don Redman made some arrangements for us.
Yes, but I mean, did you all go to Detroit?

items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Louis wanted Donald Redman to come and make some arrangements for us. band

ctx.x: I know he came from Detroit, but I didn't know about Donald Redman. I listened to that band.
For Louis. Louis wanted Donald Redman to come and make some arrangements for us. band
Because what/was it Don Redman was in?
